profile.headline: Software Engineer at AAA Auto Club South
profile.summary:
I've engineered and deployed full-stack applications, developed automation programs for oil rigs, and automated robotic packaging systems. The apps I’ve produced by myself and with others have solidified my passion for software development with a knack for back-end architecture.

In my free time, I enjoy experimenting with electronics projects, such as Arduino and raspberry pis, to automate my home as much as I can. There is always an easier way to do things thus I believe in finding it in places I spend the most time. Outside of technology, I enjoy stock trading with technical pattern analysis, fitness, and spending time with my dogs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architect and develop web, serverless, and CICD stacks on AWS by creating standard CDK practices and create tooling for security auditing/logging
- Migrate and upgrade legacy applications, pipelines, and infrastructure to AWS
Develop RESTful Node.js APIs and React for client facing and internal insurance applications
- Create roadside assistance chatbot using react, .Net core, and Microsoft’s Azure Bot Service

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Monterrey Bay Aquarium:
-	Refactored fishery and aquaculture report tracking application using .Net, Entity Framework, MSSQL, and AngularJS
-	Deployed application to multiple environments using AWS Elastic Beanstalk, S3, and Code Deploy
-       Wrote unit tests using NUnit

Federal Employee Program:
-	Architected Typescript Node upgrade on the backend for the Federal Employee Program

Union Bank:
-	Developed ticketing service using Angular 6 and Spring MVC
-	Set up multibranch pipeline for continuous integration on Jenkins
-       Wrote unit tests with Mocha and Chai

positions.title: Back End Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created applications using Apache Apex, Kafka, and HBase to pull and store affiliate data, analyze transactional data, and match categories from multiple sources

Collaborated with team to implement an artificial neural network and dimensional data models
Engineered backend RESTful APIs using Entity Framework in .Net Core and Node.js

Created responsive Angular 2 pages along with the associated MEAN full stack calls to serve affiliate data and authenticate users 

Designed a new Git workflow for development team

Implemented server side caching using Redis as both an object and value store

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed full-stack node application to remotely monitor oil rig PLC data and providing a custom UX of accessible data for said rig to rig managers and personnel
      •  Supervise electricians- Inspected work performed is per electrical code and successfully pass ABS inspections 
      •	 Test and troubleshoot electrical junction boxes, inspect cable for proper glanding and terminations as per code 

      •	 Inspect cable trays and electrical equipment as installed as per approved ABS drawings and successfully pass electrical and mechanical tests 

      •	 Design and troubleshoot remote generator controls for power system using Siemens PLCs and Woodward EasyGen 3200

      •	 Develop code to format OPC data to WITs 

      •	 Electrical Troubleshooting and Commissioning of Rig Equipment which included Drawworks, HPU, VFD House, Generator Controls, Safety System, Catwalk System, Top Drive, Anti Collision Zone Management System and Drillers Cabin Controls, 

      •	 Test and integrate rig equipment with automation network to ensure safe and proper operation

      •	 Programmed automation controls for Robotic Palletizing and Depalletizing machine 

      •	 Supervise installation and testing of conveyors, robot structure, robot controller and sensor feedback network

      •	 PLC Ladder Logic Programming with Siemens Step 7

positions.title: Network Operations Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design and implement new/existing network architectures as well as provide maintenance of existing telecommunications infrastructures
•	Map out network architectures using MAPCOM software as well as provide data entry
•	Install, test, and provide maintenance to fiber network rings

projects.title: Emoji FaceOff
projects.description:
Developed a multiplayer HTML5-based game that challenges players’ emoji vocabulary where players race against others to answer a text prompt with emojis

      •	 Architected backend server and integrated Redis to improve performance by caching commonly read data 
      •	 Integrated Mixpanel metrics in React front-end to provide data analysis of user activity and experience
      •	 Incorporated Stripe payments to facilitate in game purchases
      •	 Developed a content management system to provide admins with consolidated UGC

projects.title: Teach Me How
projects.description:
Developed an app to help connect people who want to learn anything with people who want to teach it.

      •	 Seamlessly rendered data on the AngularJs front-end by architecting back-end server with Sequelize, Redis, and Express
      •	 Improved speed of server calls by over 400% by integrating Redis for caching
      •	 Approved and oversaw progress of feature implementation
